text:
I wanted to gently remind you that punctuality is key to maintaining our professional image with clients. We have noticed a few instances of tardiness recently, and we would appreciate it if you could make an effort to arrive on time moving forward. Please remember that consistent lateness can lead to disciplinary measures.

On a lighter note, have you ever looked up at the fluffy things in the sky rain comes from? It is quite a beautiful sight and a good reminder to stay grounded and on schedule.
